766550102.text: Why, of course. I owe you both my thanks — this lighthouse looks a fair sight better now that it's being maintained.

766550103.text: Hehe, our pleasure! Although, it seems like even with a functioning lighthouse, this whole place is still really dark. There are some places the light doesn't even reach.

766550104.text: Indeed. In the graveyard, it seemed as if even time itself had forever paused at the close of the battle that night.

766550105.text: I never had any intention of changing this, but it seems that by lighting the lighthouse, you have set time in motion once again.

766550107.text: If you mean to ask whether I shall be inconvenienced in any way, the answer is no.

766550110.text: Life comes in cycles. Even without us, the ghosts that linger here would slowly disappear and return to the Ley Lines.

766550111.text: So do not worry that this lighthouse cannot shine upon every last corner of the island. As the ghosts gradually leave, so too will the fog that envelops the area.

766550109.text: Oh, don't apologize, I am not against the change.
